title: Do these 4 every day this week when the desk is your whole day
caption: Desk day workout with no equipment: four movements, eight minutes, no changing clothes. Sit-to-Stand, Wall Push-Up, Seated Knee Lift and Doorframe Row, all within reach of the chair you are already in. Save this for the week you never leave the desk.

overlays.text: Do these 4 every day this week if the desk is your whole day.
Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Out of the desk chair with no hands, sit back slowly.
Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, elbows back, chest in and out.
Seated Knee Lift. 10 each side. Sit tall, lift one knee, lower it slowly.
Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Hold the frame, lean back, pull your chest to your hands.

scenes.footer: Shrink the plan, never the standard.

overlays.text: No hinge this week. It comes back on a day with a floor to lie down on.
